from Bio import Entrez, SeqIO
from Bio.SeqUtils.ProtParam import ProteinAnalysis
import urllib.request
import json

Entrez.email = "test@example.com"

# Fetch MANE Select NP_653306.1
handle = Entrez.efetch(db="protein", id="NP_653306.1", rettype="fasta", retmode="text")
tekt4_refseq = SeqIO.read(handle, "fasta")
w_refseq = ProteinAnalysis(str(tekt4_refseq.seq)).molecular_weight()
print(f"TEKT4 RefSeq (NP_653306.1 / MANE Select): {len(tekt4_refseq.seq)} aa, {w_refseq:.1f} Da ({w_refseq/1000:.2f} kDa)")

# UniProt Q8WW24

req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    data_tekt4 = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
